column1: # Go oracle driver pin.
# Reviewed for Sprint 98 / Story 175 on 2026-09-03.
# release              the Go release whose toolchain executes the corpus. Must
#                      match docs/go-corpus/pin.tsv, because running one
#                      release's tests with another release's compiler is not an
#                      oracle.
# semantics_path       the upstream runner this driver reimplements. Historically
#                      GOROOT/test/run.go; since Go 1.21 it lives here.
# semantics_sha256     digest of that file in the pinned source. The driver
#                      REQUIRES it and refuses to run when it differs: a changed
#                      runner means the reimplementation is stale, and a stale
#                      oracle is worse than no oracle.
# tranche              the reviewed selection that is the run's denominator.
# per_action           rows selected per action by tools/go-oracle/select-tranche.sh.
# tranche_rows         total rows; the driver must report exactly this many results.
# actions              the SEVEN actions this slice commits to executing.
# unsupported_actions  the TEN upstream actions it deliberately does not. Stated
#                      here, printed by run.sh and published in the run summary,
#                      so "the oracle is green" can never be read as "upstream's
#                      full runner is green". Seven of seventeen is a tranche.
# aux_inventory        provenance for every auxiliary input the driver consumes:
#                      .out sidecars (including the ones upstream does NOT ship)
#                      and .dir manifests. The .go files are covered by
#                      docs/go-corpus/inventory.tsv.
# toolchain_pin        distribution checksums that identify the toolchain. `go
#                      version` is a forgeable string and is not trusted for this.
# release
